FOLLOW UP STRATEGY

The follow-up strategy is based on EU-TIRADS classification, FNA result and nodule dimension.

EU-TIRADS Classification

Select one option.

FNA done?

FNA Result

Dimension (mm)

Consider the longest axis of the nodule.
RECOMMENDATION

Non-oval shape

AP diameter greater than transverse.

Irregular margins

Spiculated or microlobulated.

Microcalcifications

Echogenic foci < 1 mm in solid tissue.

×

Anechoic / spongiform

Entirely or nearly entirely fluid; spongiform with tiny cystic spaces.

×

Isoechoic / hyperechoic

Similar or brighter than healthy thyroid.

×

Mildly hypoechoic

Darker than thyroid, lighter than strap muscles.

×

Marked hypoechoic

As dark or darker than strap muscles.
